DECISIONS / INTERPRETATIONS (for the evaluator): (1) Protocol 2.2 is negotiated: hello want.minor >= 2 answers minor 2; a session below minor 2 runs with Cq.on = false (no news draw, no log), because the news draw would otherwise advance rng.news in the 2.1 rng section and break the committed replay goldens (the x86_64 goldens cannot be regenerated here). helloMsg() still answers minor 1, so every old hello test is unmodified. (2) standoff_au defaults to 0 so M2 plans are unchanged (M2 tests plan to the star itself); the M4 client sends 1000. Sol (star index 0) never has a stand-off, so the return leg is d - s too and AC1's 2 x (d - s) holds. standoff_au is accepted as an ordinary new_game param but is not added to the params echo (that would change the 2.1 bytes); the consequence section carries standoff_ly. (3) Wire shapes: ship.ism{load_w_m2, drag_n, glow_w_m2, drag_energy_j} nested in the ship section; a new top-level consequence section {gap_years, news_epoch, news_age_years, progress, standoff_ly, news{tier, tier_name, template_id, star_id, slots{...}, ai_request_id, body_source, fallback_reason}, archive{unlocked}, legacy{count, appended}}; M4.3a/M4.4 may rename. (4) 'body_source + fallback_reason on the existing ai_fallback event' is read as: the ai_fallback event is unchanged (its reason is the fallback_reason) and the sim folds it into the news item, whose body_source / fallback_reason fields are emitted in the consequence section; the ai_request that links to an item is a purpose=news request opened after the item exists. (5) Legacy entries are stamped with the tick's end state (tick, tau, t, gap_years), not the mid-tick boundary. (6) first_black_hole never holds (no black-hole state before M3). (7) sim/ailang.toml: only the [exports].modules list gained stapledons/sim/consequence (the loader refuses an unlisted module); the dependency pin is untouched.

COMPOSITE: interior/interior.gd has five CanvasLayers: sky (InteriorSky SubViewport, own World3D, AgX + the M1.5a exposure, the ONE tonemap), panorama 0.15, play (its own transparent SubViewport, toon + ink GLB, the captain), foreground 1.6, HUD. The main viewport has no WorldEnvironment or 3D (test + G-M4-2). Sky camera = cam JSON x ShipFrame.ship_basis(heading), as FreeLookCamera yaw/pitch/roll in float64. The vertical fov is the view region's (78 deg). Velocity, heading and pos come from the sim (galactic play session, protocol 2.2 via the opt-in SimBridge.want_minor, standoff_au 1000). Plate parallax is clamped at the overscan. The camera follows the captain inside pan_range_m (a new optional typed field, else derived from the overscan: [6, 3.04] m on v1). FINDING (sky mirror): Starfield.galactic_to_world has det -1, so the M1 sky is a mirror image of the real sky (e.g. port = l 270). The interior shows the sky texture flip_h (Interior.SKY_FLIP_H) so it matches cam_bridge.json; G-M4-1 proves it. Raised to Mark. GLOW: interior/glow_overlay.gdshader (additive, pre-tonemap, ray from the off-centre pano camera to the R = params.bubble_radius_m wall) with CPU reference interior/forward_glow.gd. The profile pole x clamp(cos, 0, 1) mirrors glowEmittanceAt 0.7.0. Lambertian E/pi (N3); efficacy 182.565 lm/W, equal-energy white 380-780 nm from the package's ybar (tools/glow_probe), pending a spectrum ruling; photometric k, no gain. It reads ship.ism.glow_pole_w_m2, which the sim does NOT emit yet (M4.1 step 2; the sim pins 0.5.2), so the glow is off in play and the HUD says so. Review captures 10/13 are PREVIEWS driven by the package probe pole. The eye meter includes the glow. CHECK VALUES (tests/test_physics.gd test_forward_glow, from make glow-probe, VM = interpreter): glow_w_m2 2.40719e-5 / 0.281271; pole 9.628776871706524e-5 / 1.1250843031053142; profile at 0/45/80/90/120 deg within 1e-12. GOLDEN (make golden): G-M4-1 72 cases worst 0.159 px; G-M4-2 433 sky-only px, worst 0.0000; G-M4-3 6 cases (boost/cruise/brake x 2 headings) 0.085 px; G-M4-4 (a) 0.99c 0/45/80 deg and rest 0, (b) absolute pole at 0.99c (9.626e-5 vs 9.629e-5) and the cap (1.125), (c) off-centre camera worst 0.089 %, (d) photometric chain G 0.09338 vs 0.09342. WALK: interior/walk.gd (WALK_ triangles, agent radius from walk_rules, axis slide, grid routes for scripted walks). CAPTAIN: interior/captain_avatar.gd (billboard, pixel_size 1/720, foot anchor (512, 1440) at the origin via get_item_rect, stage = latest age_stage <= clock.tau, facing front/back from screen motion). Interactables: console_navigation_* opens the GalaxyMap (attached to the same sim; it ticks the sim at its host/transit rates). archive_terminal opens the Archive stub (news/log/codex from consequence fields). Keys E/M/L/K/Esc. BUNDLE: optional typed play_origin_ship_m (glb_to_ship), pan_range_m, layers.play.camera, layers.play.plate {file} (v2 hook: plate under the play layer, GLB hidden), plus interior/plate.gdshader (glow tint/rim uniform, no-op at rim_strength 0). EXPORT: make areas-stage -> areas_bundle/<area>/*.bin (include filter areas_bundle/*), loader .bin fallback + resolve_dir. export-smoke runs --m4-smoke in the .app. TEST-FIRST: tests/test_interior.gd written first; its RED run was parse errors on the missing classes (note: Godot exits 0 on a script parse error, so make interior-test greps the summary line). GATES: make test rc=0 (interior 104/0, m4-smoke OK on both bundles, validate-areas 14 + 16, physics 488/0); make golden rc=0. AC14 green. AC10 interim (G-M4-1..4) green; AC11 make capture-m4 delivered, waiting on S1; AC12 bench not run (M4.6). DEVIATIONS: LOC ~1.9k vs 480 estimate (the folded-in requirements, M4.6's G-M4 goldens, captures, export staging, walk and avatar); PR base main; the glow previews; the sky flip. OPEN FINDINGS: (1) the M1 sky mirror; (2) the glow at eps 1e-9 is ~130x the dark sky at the pole at 0.99c (not faint; it washes the starfield); (3) the glow spectrum is undefined in higgs-bubble.md; (4) the sim treats catalogue index 0 (Proxima, Gaia DR3 5853498713190525696) as Sol for the stand-off (core.ail standoffFor), but the map sends catalogue indices; (5) the transit tick (0.005 ship-yr) skips the boost and brake: M4.3a's 3 s pacing is needed; (6) the GalaxyMap's AI indicator overlaps its title.
